name: Steve
description: The default player character in Minecraft. Steve can walk through the world, gather resources, build, and fight monsters.

spawn.note: At player spawn point (if set with bed, respawn anchor, or commands) or at world spawn

attack_strength.fist: 1HP (until JE Combat Tests), 2HP (future JE Combat Tests)

fun_fact: Steve was originally meant as a placeholder name but became the official name. His female counterpart is Alex.
abilities: Can use all types of tools and weapons
Can sprint (0.3 speed), sneak, swim, and fly
Can interact with and place blocks
